question: Shogatsu is the New Year festival of which of the following country?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Japan.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****Shogatsu**

__
 
• **Shogatsu falls on the Japanese New Year's celebration, the familiar date of January 1** according to the Gregorian calendar, but in Japan the festivities stretch out before and after.
 
• It is considered one of **the biggest festivals in Japan.**
 
• Shogatsu is celebrated by enjoying several traditional foods that vary between regions in Japan.
 
• Many people **start the new year by eating soba (buckwheat) noodles at midnight for good health.**
 
• At dawn, the Emperor of Japan prays for the nation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**Brazil**

 
• **Brazil is one of the largest countries in South America.**
 
• Brazilians are very much rooted in their cultural values ​​and beliefs.
 
• For Brazilians, New Year is like a festival celebrated with full enthusiasm and fervor wrapped in traditional values.
 
• In Brazil, the new year is also pronounced as **anno nove** or in the Brazilian language it is celebrated on a large scale.
 
• They also welcome the beginning of the summer season.
 
• After their traditional festivities, Brazilians take the time to celebrate and descend upon pubs, discotheques, clubs and party halls, etc. to see the hordes of locals and tourists.

**New Zealand**

 
• **New Zealand is one of the first countries in the world to welcome the New Year.**
 
• Many people use New Year's Day to relax after celebrating New Year's Eve and New Year's countdown.
 
• Some visit family and friends, while others participate in events such as New Year's horse racing carnivals and summer fairs.
 
• **Cricket is a sporting event that many New Zealanders watch during the New Year's holiday.**

**France**

 
• **Many people in France start New Year's Day at midnight by celebrating with friends or family members.**
 
• Public and private fireworks displays are common.
 
• Many people drink champagne, sparkling white wine or hot wine.
